The '''Veshok Terrace Apartments''' was a section of living quarter apartments located in the the [[Justicar territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TOR" /> named for the [[veshok]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Veshok Terrace Apartments first appeared in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].
